title: Boolean sums with pairwise intersections of size at most one need sum (|S_w| - 1) monotone gates (known; multi-output, AND and OR allowed)
formal_statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (S : Fin m → Finset (Fin n)), (∀ i j : Fin m, i ≠ j → (S i ∩ S j).card ≤ 1) → ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ (w : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out w⟩ (List.ofFn x)) = decide (∃ v ∈ S w, x v = true)) → ∑ w, ((S w).card - 1) ≤ gates.length
plain_statement: Let S_1, ..., S_m be subsets of n input variables, any two sharing at most one element. Take one list of gates, each an AND or an OR with at most two inputs, and for each w an output wire that computes the OR of the variables in S_w on every input. Then the number of gates is at least the sum over w of (|S_w| - 1). A known result (Wegener 1987, Ch. 6.6; Pippenger 1980), stated with AND gates allowed and gates shared between outputs. Needed in Lean by the mixed-AND tradeoff for single-output monotone circuits of graphs without 4-cycles.
